title: 6 Hour Local Food Plate Jeep Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
•A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
Weight Restrictions of 250 Pounds per passenger
Age Limit between 7-70 years of age
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This 6 HOUR LOCAL FOOD TOUR will get your taste buds going crazy! Step outside of your comfort and have some ONO HAWAIIAN GRINDZ!

TOUR LOCATIONS: Leonard’s Bakery for some Hot Malasadas. Loco Moco at Rainbow Drive-In. The Famous Mike’s Huli Huli Chicken to try the Best Kiawe Wood cooked Huli Chicken on Oahu. The Kona Coffee and Macadamia Nut Tropical Farms. The Famous Yellow Shrimp Shack for some of the best Local Garlic and Coconut Shrimp. Kahuku Land Farms Farmers Market to grab some famous North Shore fried banana lumpia. Ted’s Bakery for Coconut Haupia chocolate pie. Haleiwa Town for the Famous Hawaiian Shave Ice. From there we head to the either a Old Tiki Bar, Sugar Plantation or Bakery depending on drop off Resort Location. FOOD IS NOT INCLUDED!
